{{Quote|I am the Warden of the Dawn Temple, and I greet you, seekers of knowledge. Your arrival is untimely, but not unwelcome. You have brought light into these caves, so let us hope you can endure the shadow it casts.|The Warden|<ref name="Lure" />}}
"'''The Warden'''" was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who served as the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] for one of the three [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]s of [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]'s [[Dawn Temple]].<ref name="Lure" />
